St Kilda Beach: kept as dunedin-17 (own OSM beach, not the shared Ocean Beach point; held for a photo). Wānaka and Lake Wakatipu not made spots of themselves. TSS Earnslaw not proposed: Walter Peak High Country Farm (queenstown-4) is kept. Shotover Jet kept per skeptic. Other benchmarks (Red Rocks, Kapiti Island, Lake Coleridge, Sumner, Godley Head, Lyttelton, Birdlings Flat, Hump Ridge Track, Ohakune Carrot, Ninety Mile Beach) belong to other regions; Ninety Mile Beach, Hump Ridge Track already shipped. Negative benchmarks in Otago: none present; Dunedin Town Hall exterior, University of Otago (review), Gasworks Museum (review) held out.
benchmark.catlins_overlap: Waipapa Point, Florence Hill Lookouts and Surat Bay are not duplicated here (region-southland catlins-7/8/9); Tunnel Hill and Waipohatu Waterfalls Track are not in the Southland placement and are placed here as catlins-13/14 with a conflict note on Tunnel Hill.

review_list_for_owner.case: Downgraded: the candidate is matched to the wrong place. Its coordinates (-38.65, 175.92) and 4,677 views are Kinloch near Lake Taupo; the Otago Kinloch is a tiny lakehead settlement (lodge, Greenstone/Caples access). Gateway village whose draw is the track beyond it (Pipiriki case). Needs its own source and real coordinates (about -44.85, 168.33, verify).

review_list_for_owner.name: Gillespie Pass Circuit
review_list_for_owner.case: Stays review. For: Gillespie Pass Circuit is a known multi-day route. Against: one source, backcountry.

review_list_for_owner.name: Fantail Falls Walk
review_list_for_owner.case: Stays review: DOC names the Haast Highway short walks (Blue Pools, Thunder Creek, Fantail, Roaring Billy) together; 10-minute stops, so keep or drop with Roaring Billy as a pair, consistent with Thunder Creek (kept).

review_list_for_owner.name: Roaring Billy Falls Walk
review_list_for_owner.case: Stays review, paired with Fantail Falls Walk (same DOC short-walk set).

review_list_for_owner.name: Cardrona Hotel
review_list_for_owner.case: Decision: stays review. For: 1863 hotel open daily, the Crown Range stop beside the Bra Fence, half an hour for a drink and photos. Against: single pub venue, only one source and I could not find a counted visitor listing (Wikivoyage has no Cardrona page). Keep only if a Lonely Planet or newzealand.com listing is confirmed; otherwise reject.
